description: This file defines interfaces for an event threading system, including factory and thread classes, with methods for creating threads, adding event handlers, and flushing events.

classes.name: IEventThreadFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating IEventThread instances.

classes.name: IEventThread
classes.description: Interface for an event thread, allowing adding event handlers and flushing events.

methods.name: createFactory
methods.description: Creates and returns a shared pointer to an IEventThreadFactory instance.

methods.name: createEventThread
methods.description: Creates and returns a unique pointer to an IEventThread instance, optionally with a thread name.

methods.name: flush
methods.description: Flushes any waiting events in the thread.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds an event handler function to the thread, supporting functions with or without arguments.
